### 2) EX01–36 — findings (critical/high only)

**CRITICAL — full-room two-device takeover can require a second slot.**  
`8-9-hh-world-2-ke-hoach-tong-the-va-chat-luong.txt` L233–239: new device must **admission succeed then** fence old epoch; L239 also allows “transfer XOR release/re-admit”. EX01 L300–305 and `03-ARCHITECTURE.md` A05 L161–162 forbid two reservations. If A holds the last of 32, B cannot admit while A’s hold still counts unless transfer happens **in the same registry TX** as fence.  
**Edit:** EX01 + L233–239 + A05 L161–162: one atomic TX authenticates B, **rebinds the existing account room_hold to the new session_epoch** (or release+reserve in that TX), fences e1; never need a free extra slot. Fixture: `occupied=cap`. UI ≤2s only on healthy path (already).

**HIGH — EX07 retry vs EX09 quota.**  
L271–275 / EX07 L324–327: lost room disk before result → unconfirmed, “cho chơi lại”, no mint. EX09 L332–338: quota reserved on durable `attempt_id` before start; consume/release once. Retry is not required to **reuse the same attempt_id** and not open a second attempt while pending. That allows double grant or stuck quota.  
**Edit:** EX07: retry = same `attempt_id` + same quota reservation; new attempt only after consume/release/expiry; if API already committed, reconnect reads receipt (A03 L102–104), do not replay.

**HIGH — EX09 binds Solo P2-03 to online mailbox.**  
EX09 L332–338 lists P2-03 but requires durable mailbox / attempt TX. P2-03 is Solo local save (`06-ROADMAP.md` L166–172; P02 namespaces).  
**Edit:** P2-03 = local full-inventory reject/UI, no cloud mailbox. Mailbox + reservation TX only P3-04/P4-02.

Leases/handoff (EX02/EX13, L245–254), atomic shop TX (L270, A06 L191–196), block/privacy (EX14, P04 L73–83, no hard PvP collision), offline inventory (L146–151, EX22, no queued Solo→Online money) are otherwise consistent. EX14/EX22/block/offline: no extra critical/high.

### 3) DB-D1–D4 vs PostgreSQL
Matches required policy:

- D1: disposable/local `fsync=on` + `synchronous_commit=on` ≠ host/region proof.  
- D2: primary + sync standby **different hosts**; `synchronous_commit=on` waits for **standby durable flush** (not `remote_write`); ACK only after protected commit; RPO=0 for **ACK’d** txs on **one host loss if survivor has WAL**; no auto async downgrade; fence old primary then promote; protected writes stay blocked until sync redundancy returns (or explicit owner policy). P3-01 = config/fixture; P6-02 = real two-domain drill.  
- D3: archive/PITR/region/both-hosts/logical corruption have **measured** RPO ≠ all-disaster RPO0; leftover `command_id`/tombstone **must not mint balances** (EX31 L423–426, D3 L497–501).  
- D4: deletion journal outside restore snapshot; replay before traffic (EX32, A06 L211–214).  
- RTO≤4h = **drill target**, not a guarantee (D2 L475; Q06 L172–174; P6-02 L311–313).  
- Disposable invited test must not be called persistent alpha (L515–518; Q06 L179).

PG 18 §26.2.8: sync needs `synchronous_standby_names`; `on` = standby **flushed to durable storage**; default streaming is async; commits can **wait forever** if sync standby is gone (supports fail-closed, not silent async). §26.2.8.4: app must not treat commit as ACK until standbys confirmed; recovered primary may show waiting txs committed while standby does not — supports **fence-before-promote**. §19.5.1 Table 19.1: `on` survives standby OS crash; `remote_write` does not. WAL archive/PITR ≠ sync RPO0.

### 4) Capacity (independent)
CPU-time ≠ wall: `rooms_cpu = floor((4×1000×0.6)/(6×30)) = floor(2400/180) = 13`. Do not invert `1/wall_p95`.  
RAM: `floor(10/0.6)=16`.  
Full-duplex **per direction**: 1 Gbps×70% = 87.5 MB/s (decimal). 32×30 kB/s = 0.96 MB/s/room → `rooms_down=91`; 32×10 kB/s → `rooms_up=273`; `min(13,16,91)=13`. **Not** 13×32=416 measured CCU (master L591).  
N+1: peak 1000 / 32 / occ=1 → 32 rooms; `r_node=8` → `ceil(32/8)+1=5`. occ=0.6 → `ceil(1000/19.2)=53` → `ceil(53/8)+1=8`.  
Egress: 1000×30 kB/s = 30 MB/s = 240 Mbps; 30d peak = 77.76 TB; avg 200 = 15.552 TB. Peak sizes NIC; average sizes bill. Predicted rooms ≠ measured CCU.
